mapper.insert: insert into report (board_idx, category, content, report_user_idx) values (#{boardIdx}, #{category}, #{content}, #{reportUserIdx})
mapper.select: select count(*) > 0 from report where board_idx = #{boardIdx} and report_user_idx = #{reportUserIdx}
select category, content, count(*) as count from report where board_idx = #{boardIdx} group by category, content order by count desc
